currentParagraphText: “At least you’re honest about it.” Jake couldn’t help but chuckle. “I hope you understand why I would be skeptical about fighting alongside you, though. You’ve shown yourself to be quite willing to ambush others if an opportunity arises. Also, from what I know, you Rainbowfeathers are quite notorious for holding grudges. Am I really to believe you won’t try to exact revenge if given the chance?”
